mapper.select:
select id, user_id, login_type, display_name, status, first_login_time, last_login_time, create_time, update_time from market_user
and (user_id like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or display_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by last_login_time desc, id desc
mapper.insert: insert into market_user(user_id, login_type, display_name, status, first_login_time, last_login_time, create_time, update_time) values(#{userId}, #{loginType}, #{displayName}, #{status}, now(), now(), now(), now())
